properties.evidence: That idea proposes computing required depth from a 3-7 span-of-control bound. This is the hazard it runs into: the only systems available to calibrate that bound against are organically grown, and Conway's Law — rule 3 of the very same doctrine — predicts organic growth will LOOK conformant at some boundaries without any SE having occurred. So a threshold tuned on this evidence would be fitted to what accretion produces rather than to what good decomposition needs. It does not refute the idea; it says the number cannot be calibrated from anything currently in reach, which is a reason to REPORT fan-out rather than ship a threshold.
